concept: The Proof Loom: a Victorian observatory instrument becomes a living tapestry, gathering separate strands of reasoning into one durable web. Memorable, crafted, and atmospheric, like an archival scientific plate brought to life.
composition: Square master: an irregular circular weave floats within a dark brass astrolabe frame against charcoal. Center it in a generous safe area for tall 500-by-570 and wide 350-by-320 crops. Loose threads enter from varied directions, visibly cross, and form one fabric. Open spacing keeps paths legible; ivory highlights gather near center, with antique gold at the edges.
strands: Use traceable filaments of ivory silk, muted gold wire, and smoky pewter thread. Show tactile over-under crossings, occasional braids, and varied tension. Interlace them into one field, not dots or stations. Distinct paths suggest proof conditions without implying a fixed count, sequence, or one condition per strand.
brandConnection: Match the charcoal, ivory, antique-gold palette and Victorian mathematical mood. Conceal a small crescent and star in the brass geometry; use crafted materials, shadow, and controlled light to suggest precision and privacy.
avoid: No people, words, numerals, crypto marks, coins, nodes, radial spokes, circuits, neon, generic gold fractals, or numbered strands. Avoid implying exactly three proofs, seven sequential steps, or automatic execution.
imagePrompt: Square hero illustration: a black-brass Victorian observatory loom holds one coherent web of continuous ivory silk, antique-gold wire, and smoky pewter filaments. Every strand is traceable through visible over-under weaving and occasional braids. Asymmetrical, tactile archival realism; engraved brass, deep charcoal shadows, warm ivory light, restrained gold glints. Center the web with dark margins for portrait and landscape crops. Hide a tiny crescent and star. No people, text, logos, crypto symbols, nodes, labels, fixed counts, or infographic styling.
